title: Discounts
emptyHelp: Use Create discount to offer a code or waive the sign-up fee.
name: Discount name
codeHelp: Optional: 3–40 letters, numbers or hyphens. Codes ignore letter case. Without a code, only staff can apply this discount.
locked: Terms are locked because this discount has been used. Create another discount to change them.
termsHelp: Terms can only change before the first use. Memberships keep the terms applied to them.
limitsHelp: Leave limits blank for no limit. The end date and use limit control new applications; existing memberships keep their discount.
plansHelp: Leave all plans unchecked to allow every plan.
invalid: Check the discount name, code, amount, duration and limits. Choose a price discount or a sign-up fee waiver.
conflict: This record changed, its name or code is already in use, or its terms are locked after use. Close and reload before trying again. Used terms need a new discount.
failed: The discount could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
noEligible: No active discounts for this plan.
eligibilityHelp: Availability is checked when saving. Ended or used-up discounts cannot be applied.
confirmRemove: Remove this discount from the next invoice? Issued invoices stay the same and the use is not returned.
nextInvoice: Changes apply from the next invoice, without proration. Replacing a discount takes a new use; issued invoices stay the same.
kept: The discount is kept on the new plan.
ended: The discount ends because it does not apply to the new plan.
noDiscount: There is no discount to carry to the new plan.
